title: Energy baseline validity in continuous process industries — scoping review package
description: Records, instruments, code and derived results of a scoping review of energy performance indicator (EnPI) and energy baseline (EnB) models, with detailed charting of studies in a predefined list of continuous-process sectors. Includes the screening and eligibility records, two model-assisted extractions of Corpus A and their reconciliation, the Corpus B charting records, the September 2026 model verification, the checks executed in October 2026 under Amendment 3 of the registered protocol, the code behind the tables and figures of the article, and its Supplementary Tables S1–S3. Full texts of the reviewed publications and publisher abstracts are not included. Data and documentation under CC BY 4.0; code under the MIT licence. Protocol: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TDW6C.
